text:
### As of 2026-09-21T06:30:00Z — Rahu Mahadasha / Venus Antardasha  
**Current phase:** partnership exploration is supported, but best used for relationship-building, terms-testing, and market validation rather than irreversible commitment.

**Why:** You are in **Rahu Mahadasha 2013-04-22T11:54:06.908Z to 2031-04-22T20:39:42.908Z**, with **Venus Antardasha 2024-11-09T01:07:22.508Z to 2027-11-09T18:34:58.508Z**. Natal Rahu is in the 4th, showing unconventional foundations and restlessness around security; Venus is strong in its own sign Taurus in the 11th with Moon and Mercury, favouring networks, patrons, gains, and collaborative commercial circles. For business partnership, this is the strongest dasha sub-period shown here because Venus also rules the 11th and 4th from Cancer Lagna.

From Lagna, transiting Mars and Jupiter are in Cancer/1st: initiative is high, but judgment can become self-driven. From Moon, Mars in the 3rd supports courage and outreach; Saturn in the 11th supports gains, but its favourable rule is partly **vedha-obstructed by Sun/Mercury in the 5th from Moon**. Rahu in the 10th from Moon supports ambition, yet Ketu in the 4th may disturb stability. Direction: proceed, but keep structures clear and written.

---

### As of 2027-11-09T18:34:59.508Z — Rahu Mahadasha / Sun Antardasha  
**Current phase:** the tone shifts from cooperative expansion to authority, control, and visibility; partnership plans need stronger role definition and exit clauses.

**Why:** The Mahadasha remains **Rahu 2013-04-22T11:54:06.908Z to 2031-04-22T20:39:42.908Z**, but Antardasha has just changed to **Sun 2027-11-09T18:34:58.508Z to 2028-10-03T11:49:15.308Z**. Natal Sun is in Gemini in the 12th house: this can bring behind-the-scenes dealings, foreign/remote links, expenses, confidentiality, or reduced transparency. Sun also rules the 2nd house of capital, speech, and accumulated resources, so partnership discussions may revolve around ownership, contribution, valuation, and who has final say.

From Moon, Sun and Mercury in the 6th are supportive for handling disputes, paperwork, competition, and due diligence. Saturn remains favourable in the 11th from Moon, with no obvious 5th-house vedha shown here, so gains through networks remain possible. But from Lagna, Rahu is transiting the 7th: partnership itself becomes karmically charged, attractive yet unstable. Mars and Venus in the 5th from Lagna may increase speculation or emotional enthusiasm. Direction: negotiate, audit, and define authority before binding.

---

### What changed  
The main change is the Antardasha: **Venus AD ended at 2027-11-09T18:34:58.508Z**, and **Sun AD began immediately after**. Venus favoured alliance-building because natal Venus is strong in the 11th. Sun shifts attention to control, money terms, visibility, and hidden costs because natal Sun is 2nd lord placed in the 12th. Transits also change: 2026 had stronger “initiate and network” signals, but with vedha to Saturn’s gains; 2027 has better dispute-handling from Moon, yet Rahu in the 7th from Lagna makes partnership more compelling and riskier. This is a traditional interpretation, not a verified forecast.
